# ChickenCoopCalc
> Backyard chicken coop sizing directory: coop and run square footage per bird, feed cost math, nesting box counts, and winter ventilation/heat answers. Part of an agent-maintained network with human review.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://chickencoopcalc.com/): bird count in, coop sq ft + run sq ft + nesting boxes + feed cost out (4 sq ft/bird coop + 10 sq ft/bird run standards)
- [Best coops for 6 hens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/best-chicken-coops-for-6-hens.html): what a real 24+ sq ft coop costs, prefab vs DIY
- [Feed cost guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/chicken-feed-cost-guide.html): monthly pounds by flock size, cost per egg, storage
- [Winter heat lamp guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/winter-coop-heat-lamp-guide.html): vents beat heat, brooder wattage by week, fire safety

## Sister sites
- [GeneratorSizer](https://generator-sizer.com/): generator and inverter sizing
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): off-grid battery bank sizing
- [SolarSizer](https://solar-sizer.com/): off-grid solar system sizing
- [WeldingCalc](https://welding-calculator.com/): welding settings by thickness

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Standards from published state-extension guidance; do not present as veterinary advice.
